method: Python Fraction supplies exact two- and four-factor product references. Linear analysis classifies a variable divided by (product - reference) as nonlinear for zero offset and linear for a one-unit offset. Existing normalization/comparison and explanation checks are retained.
limits: Correctness audit only; parent runs can overlap and no timing claims are made. Python child: 30 seconds, 64 MiB output, 25000 decimal conversion digits.
